player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwla {player_id} le xɔxɔ {num_rounds} tọn IteratedTwoThirdsAverage tọn mẹ.
Gbọnvona xɔxɔ, dindona nuṣẹṣẹ to {min_guess} po {max_guess} po ṣẹnṣẹn.
Gbọn xɔxɔ awe godo, alọyi wẹ (2/3)x(awetọ nuṣẹṣẹ awe lẹ tọn),
bo azɔnwla he dindona nuṣẹṣẹ he klo hugan alọyi wẹ wẹndi xɔxɔ lọ.
Gbálẹ nuṣẹṣẹ towe to fọmatsi '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E ma sɔgbe ǎ; mi byɔ ɖɔ mi na wlan nǔ e a lin é ɖi [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nuṣẹṣẹ dona tin to {min_guess} po {max_guess} po ṣẹnṣẹn.

message.round_guesses: Azɔnwla 0 dindona {guess0}; Azɔnwla 1 dindona {guess1}. Enẹwutu Alọyi wẹ: {target}.
message.round_draw: Nǔ e è ɖɔ ɔ́ cí nǔ ɖɔhun.
